items.title: Simple Analogy: Adjusting the Volume of a Speaker

source_refs.note: 'Simple Analogy: Adjusting the Volume of a Speaker' under topic 6.8, as printed (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: Hyperparameter tuning is like adjusting the volume of a speaker. If the volume is too high, the sound becomes distorted and unclear. If the volume is too low, the sound cannot be heard properly. However, when the volume is set at the right level, the sound becomes clear and balanced.
Similarly, in machine learning, if hyperparameters are not set properly, the model may perform poorly. The correct hyperparameter values help the model learn better and produce more accurate results.
